title: Isolation of Autophagosomes and Proteinase K Protection Assay
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Use this AP-enriched fraction for downstream applications.
Analyze by SDS-PAGE and Western blotting.

steps.title: Prepare cell lines
steps.instruction: Use the following cell lines: HAP1 ATG9A‑GFP (RRID:CVCL_E2TR) and HAP1 ATG9A‑GFP ATG2 DKO (RRID:CVCL_F0LE).

steps.title: Seed cells in dishes
steps.instruction: Seed cells in 15 cm dishes, using two dishes per condition.

steps.title: Treat cells with EBSS and BafA
steps.instruction: Treat the seeded cells with Earle’s Balanced Salt Solution (EBSS) and 100 nanomolar (nM) Bafilomycin A1 (BafA). Incubate for 02:00:00 (2 h) before harvesting.

steps.title: Harvest cells by trypsinization
steps.instruction: Harvest cells by trypsinization and pellet them by centrifugation.

steps.title: Wash cell pellet with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellet once with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in Vesicle Isolation Buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 800 µL Vesicle Isolation Buffer (VIB) containing: 20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 250 mM sucrose, 1× cOmplete™ EDTA‑free protease inhibitors (Roche), 20 mM β‑glycerophosphate, 1 mM sodium orthovanadate, 1 mM NaF, and 1 mM EDTA pH 8.0. Transfer the suspension to LoBind tubes (Eppendorf, Cat# 0030108116).

steps.title: Lyse cells with needle passes
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells by passing the suspension through a 26‑gauge needle.

substeps.instruction: Pass the suspension through the needle 30 times.
Repeat the needle passage for another 30 passes.

steps.title: Low‑speed spin and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 00:10:00 (10 min). Collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash pellet and clear debris
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet and remove residual debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL VIB to the pellet, then centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.
Pool the supernatants and centrifuge at 2,000 × g, 4 °C for 00:05:00 (5 min). Collect the resulting supernatant.

steps.title: High‑speed spin to pellet vesicles
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected supernatant at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 00:20:00 (20 min). Collect the pellet.

steps.title: Wash vesicle pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the vesicle pellet and re‑pellet.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 500 µL Wash Buffer (WB) containing 20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, and 1× cOmplete EDTA‑free protease inhibitors.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in DTT buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 500 µL WB supplemented with 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT).

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add proteinase K (Thermo Scientific, Cat# EO0491) to a final concentration of 10 µg mL⁻¹ and incubate for 00:20:00 (20 min) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Add PMSF and incubate
steps.instruction: Add phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride (PMSF) to a final concentration of 1 mM (Santa Cruz Biotechnology, Cat# sc‑482875) and incubate on ice for 00:10:00 (10 min).

steps.title: Final high‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 00:10:00 (10 min) and collect the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in SDS loading buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 15 µL WB 6× SDS loading buffer.
